response.sql: WITH event_budgets AS (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) as total_spent, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event, CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN CAST(total_spent AS REAL) / total_amount ELSE NULL END as spend_ratio FROM event_budgets), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as avg_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios WHERE spend_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT link_to_event, spend_ratio, CASE WHEN spend_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN spend_ratio / (SELECT avg_spend_ratio FROM avg_ratio) ELSE NULL END as relative_ratio FROM event_ratios ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
